warnings: The /products GET endpoint does not explicitly support search or filtering by keyword as per the OpenAPI contract. The behavior of keyword search queries is not documented, so no tests using search query parameters are generated.
Behavior for entering an empty search keyword is not defined in the functional specifications.

testCases.title: Retrieve all products with Accept: application/json header
expectedResponseChecks: each item in response matches ProductResponse schema
contractChecks: Response body follows ProductResponse schema per product
testCases.notes: Standard positive test retrieving the full list of products in JSON format.

testCases.title: Retrieve all products with Accept: text/xml header
expectedResponseChecks: response contains product elements conforming to ProductResponse schema
testCases.notes: Verify response serialization in XML format as supported.

testCases.title: Retrieve all products expecting empty array if no products exist
contractChecks: Response body is an empty array
testCases.notes: Tests the scenario where no products exist, equivalent to no matches.

testCases.title: Response contract validation for all products endpoint
contractChecks: Response body complies with OpenAPI defined schema for ProductResponse
testCases.notes: Validates that the response matches the agreed contract for product listings.

testCases.title: Boundary test for large number of products retrieved
preconditions: System populated with a large product catalog (e.g., 1000+ products)
contractChecks: Response body conforms to ProductResponse schema for each item
testCases.notes: Tests system behavior and response correctness when large product volume is returned.

testCases.title: Error Handling: Unsupported Accept header returns 406 Not Acceptable
expectedResponseChecks: response contains error message indicating unsupported media type
testCases.notes: Verifies server correctly rejects unsupported Accept headers.
